messages:
Alex: heads-up — starting the deploy for nomad-worker-v3 in the 23:00 UTC change window. will toggle ff:fast-path gradually.
Maria: thanks — what are the ramp steps?  we should pin the old routing for 10% until telemetry looks ok.
Alex: plan: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 35% -> 100% with 10–15m soak at each step. pin older route at 10% if any error spike.
Sara: +1. add rate-limit throttle at 2% step to reduce risk of token storms. also enable detailed traces for that cohort.
Jun: DeployBot: queued deploy nomad-worker-v3 on pool-east-1. ETA ~6m. job id: nwv3-20260323-42
DeployBot: note: feature flag fast-path (ff.fast_path) currently OFF for prod. will be toggled by releasebot at steps.
Priya: ReleaseNotesBot, can you attach the short blurb for this change for oncall?
ReleaseNotesBot: https://redwood.internal/notes/nwv3-deploy-20260323 - summary + rollback steps included.
Maria: rollback criteria: increase in 5xxs > 2x baseline for 10m, or p95 latency regressing > 150ms. if hit, immediate roll to pinned route and disable ff.fast_path.
Alex: operator playbook: use /deploy abort nwv3-20260323-42 to stop; /deploy pin-route old-route-east to force pinning.
Sara: logging snippet for detailed traces (paste once enabled):
```
logger.info(\"ff.fast_path cohort=%s step=%s error_rate=%f\", cohort, step, err_rate)
```
Jun: at 1788012358 — started first toggle to 0.5% via releasebot.
Maria: saw 1 500 in first minute, looks transient. holding at 0.5 for another 8m.
Priya: copying release notes to #incidents just in case.
Alex: moving to 2% now. enabling rate-limit throttle delta=+10rps for cohort.
DeployBot: toggle success — ff.fast_path = 2% in prod. observability: https://observability/redwood/fastpath?since=5m
Sara: traces look clean. p95 flat. continue to 10% in 12m.
Jun: scheduled pin: old-route-east pinned until 2026-04-06 unless manually unpinned.
Maria: pre-announce to partners list done. small reminder: if cost spikes > 20% notify eng-cost.
Alex: moving to 10% now. also publishing a short internal note in docs: "nomad-worker-v3: expected perf improvement ~12% for tail latency"
Priya: confirmed ReleaseNotesBot posted final notes after canary success.
DeployBot: roll completed to 100% at 1788012420. ff.fast_path = ON for all traffic.
Alex: thanks team. keeping enhanced traces for 2h. will close change window at 01:00 UTC.
Maria: follow-up action: open a small eval job to validate quality regressions for the next 24h, ping if anomalies.
Sara: nice — great coordination :thumbsup:
